description: Free. If you decide not to buy, tell us why (type no_purchase, reason no_budget, cost_too_high, dataset_usability_uncertain or other with a comment): we use this feedback to provide a better offering. If you paid, tell us which other datasets, or other data within the dataset, would be useful (type wishlist, wanted): we use this feedback to provide better datasets, so we can become the one-stop shop for agent dataset needs. Do not include personal data.

comment.description: Optional free text for no_purchase; required when reason is other.

dataset.description: Dataset the feedback is about (optional for wishlist).

reason.description: Required for no_purchase: no_budget, cost_too_high, dataset_usability_uncertain or other (then explain in comment).

type.description: no_purchase: why you did not buy. wishlist: which other datasets or data you want.

wanted.description: Required for wishlist: other datasets, or other data within this dataset, that would be useful.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback (free)
